headline: Iran army says it shot down a US made LUCAS drone over the Persian Gulf
label: NEWS
caption:
Iran claims to have destroyed an American drone over strategic waters 🚨

The Iranian army announced on Monday that it shot down an American LUCAS drone over the Persian Gulf, according to Iran semi official Tasnim news agency.

Iran army public relations office stated that the aircraft was struck east of the Strait of Hormuz by indigenous air defense systems.

US military officials have not yet confirmed or publicly commented on the reported incident.
